description:
When overseas-born residents arrived in Australia: from before 1951 to 2021, with a recent-arrivals total, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 5,200 suburbs and localities and 505 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/year-of-arrival`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_born_overseas, arrived_2016_to_2021_count, arrived_2016_to_2021_pct, arrived_before_1951_count, arrived_before_1951_pct, arrived_1951_1960_count, arrived_1951_1960_pct, arrived_1961_1970_count, arrived_1961_1970_pct, arrived_1971_1980_count, arrived_1971_1980_pct, arrived_1981_1990_count, arrived_1981_1990_pct, arrived_1991_2000_count, arrived_1991_2000_pct, arrived_2001_2010_count, arrived_2001_2010_pct, arrived_2011_2015_count, arrived_2011_2015_pct, arrived_2016_count, arrived_2016_pct, arrived_2017_count, arrived_2017_pct, arrived_2018_count, arrived_2018_pct, arrived_2019_count, arrived_2019_pct, arrived_2020_count, arrived_2020_pct, arrived_2021_count, arrived_2021_pct, arrived_not_stated_count, arrived_not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
